decision_question: Are the 24 red-teaming packages clearly named, structurally portable, safely bounded, composable, and ready for local catalog preview without claiming operational security performance?
acceptance_criteria: Every package directory uses the okhp3- prefix and matches its frontmatter name.
Every package directory is at most 36 characters and every package has portable frontmatter.
Every package states scope, safety boundaries, validation loop, output contract, and integration behavior.
Credential, data exposure, exploitation, lateral assessment, and persistence packages are limited to synthetic lab or evidence-review use.
Every package has a version-matched evaluation design with a declared external holdout and no fabricated performance result.
The family overview lists every package and does not make unsupported timing, cost, or live-system claims.

shared_model_or_source_limits: The Codex reviewer/editor shares the repository and source context with the Claude-originated drafts.
No independent external reviewer, live executor, or unseen holdout was available in this run.

initial_reviews.scope: Names, adjacency, package structure, safety boundaries, evaluation design, and family composition.
initial_reviews.result: Structural and analytical issues were repaired; performance and live-system claims remain unverified.
evidence: Current repository guidance and local Foundry, equilibrium, promotion, and catalog contracts were read.
The strict skill validator returned 24 validated packages with no errors or warnings.
The package inventory and directory-length audit were run against the current checkout.

falsification_hypotheses: A shorter package may have lost its actual defensive contract while appearing structurally valid.
The family may imply that analytical or lab evidence proves live-system security.
Parallel agents may escalate scope if handoff authority is not explicitly constrained.
test_results: Each package retains a purpose, inputs, procedure, safety boundary, validation loop, output contract, and integration section.
The family now labels performance evidence not-run and forbids live-system inference.
The family requires identical written scope, synthetic fixtures, stop conditions, and reviewer reconciliation for delegated lanes.

negotiator.decision: Defer performance and external promotion claims; allow local structural validation and catalog preview.
decisive_evidence: Strict validator output for all 24 package directories.
Version-matched evaluation design files with external-required holdout status.
No independent benchmark or live test result in the current evidence set.
unresolved_items: Owner decision on whether to write generated root catalog and Forge metadata.
Independent external review and controlled holdout execution.
A conventional project-local source and publication mirror are not present for promotion synchronization.

limitations: Structural validation is not a penetration test, control-efficacy result, or production-readiness proof.
No live with-skill versus without-skill benchmark was run.
No independent external equilibrium review was available.
The original long drafts and untracked root artifacts remain preserved separately and were not treated as validated current packages.
follow_up: Run cataloger in dry-run mode and inspect generated diff before any catalog write.
Obtain owner authorization for generated catalog changes if the preview is accepted.
Run controlled external holdout evaluations against version 2.0.0 packages.
Prepare per-package promotion manifests only after source, mirror, and canonical acceptance paths are explicit.
